name: @lcai-p2p/supervisor
description: Installs, supervises and updates a Lightchain worker
//upgrade: Development link, generated by pear touch and held only on a developer machine. A production release needs its own link under the multisig policy; do not ship this one.
//pear: pear stage does not read .gitignore. Without this the staged drive carries the compiled binary from out/ and the build toolchain, and every user replicates them.

scripts.//make: Builds run from the workspace root via scripts/make.mjs. Invoking bare-build from this directory produces a binary that crashes at startup.
